revisions.description: Changed Shared .agents compatibility from an exhaustive per-official-tool classification to a non-exhaustive, source-attributed research snapshot of discovered candidates; missing rows now carry no compatibility conclusion and verification wording is replaced by research/observation wording.
revisions.reason: An exhaustive matrix would imply that every OpenSpec-supported client must be continually tested. The intended product value is to surface currently known or plausible shared-path consumers without asserting complete ecosystem coverage.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Replaced the heavy shared-path header and duplicated client enumeration with a compact target-contract summary: agents/zed use slash references, Codex requires an explicit codex target and dollar references, and only a Codex-led tree is presented as shareable with slash-style clients.
revisions.reason: The researched client rows already answer which clients may consume `.agents/skills`. The more important header information is that the same physical path has asymmetric OpenSpec invocation contracts and an agents-only setup is not a Codex setup.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Offset the tool-reference dialog overlay and centering container by the persistent 3rem Activity Bar so the dialog is constrained to the application content viewport at half-FHD and narrower widths.
revisions.reason: The dialog was centered against the full browser viewport, allowing the z-60 Activity Bar to cover its left edge around 960px width.
revisions.author: AI
